definitions.gloss: high volume; loud volume; full blast
definitions.explanation: A loud level of sound, typically from speakers, music, or electronic devices. Often implies the volume is excessively or notably loud.

examples.japanese: {大音量|だいおんりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listen to music at high volume.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{大音量|だいおんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the TV at loud volume from the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大音量|だいおんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Listening to loud music through earphones for a long time is bad for your ears.

notes:
Composed of {大|だい} (large, great) and ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→音量：10009_onryou⟧ (volume, sound level). Often used with the particle で to indicate the manner of listening or playing.
